verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board provides stronger region tinting and semantic color but lacks its spacious hierarchy, with denser labels and several harder-to-follow routed connections.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The major traffic, regional, global-service, control, and failover bands use the frame broadly, though the upper and outer margins are somewhat oversized.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes have adequate breathing room, but several chips and annotations are cramped against wires or nearby objects, especially around Region A, the global-data row, and the control-plane flows.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct tinted containers clearly separate the traffic edge, three regional deployments, global data, control plane, and failover operations; the repeated regional panels are especially easy to scan.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, orange, purple, green, and red are used consistently enough to distinguish routing, control, data, recovery, and failure concepts, although the number of simultaneous hues adds visual load.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junction glyphs appear, but several arrowheads terminate at bends or crowded boundaries, and some partially obscured labels make routing mechanics conspicuous.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The three regional panels and bottom recovery sequence hold strong registers, but density jumps sharply between sparse regional interiors and crowded global/control sections, producing uneven rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: The main top corridor is clean, but long inter-section runs, close parallel paths, boundary-hugging routes, and label collisions around the lower middle make several dependencies difficult to trace.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the denser board under grade third at 6.5.
